description: Local flow contributing to reservoir inflow during the observed period.

Local flow contributing to reservoir inflow during the observed period. It is calculated as Downstream Observed Reservoir Inflow (QI) − Sum of Routed Flows from Upstream Basins. This provides an observed estimate of local basin contribution that can be compared with the simulated local QR
